name: No-Shadow Strike (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Improved Feint feat

Benefit(s): The ninja can move with such sudden speed that even her shadow can’t keep up with the motion. The ninja may make a Bluff check to feint as a swift action. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.
